items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: A fellow named Gilbert Young, he had a lot of influence over me. His playing influenced me a lot.

ctx.x: To any of the places you remember going? I mean to listen to music? Rather, you know, in the audience rather than as a player?

Yeah, now the WPA band, that's the band they had, where my first teacher was teaching, because when he started directing the WPA band, he had to give up his students. He couldn't have any other job, couldn't have another job working with the WPA band. But he, when he was there with the WPA band, I used to go out in Shakespeare Park. They call it Davis Park now. And I would go out there and hear them play, because there was a trumpet player in that band. I used to admire his tone, his style. A fellow named Gilbert…
Who'd you work for on Mardi Gras Day?
